title: Demonic Rune Stone
description: A hooded sorcerer in a blue and red robe stands in the foreground with his hand raised toward a large ancient stone slab covered in glowing orange runes. A massive demonic entity with red eyes, horns, and clawed hands emerges from swirling dark smoke behind the stone, looming over the scene under a vibrant aurora borealis.
prompt: A hooded sorcerer in a flowing blue and red robe stands in a desolate rocky landscape, reaching toward a massive weathered stone slab inscribed with glowing orange runes that drip like molten lava. Behind the stone, a giant terrifying demon with black smoky skin, glowing red eyes, and large horns emerges from swirling dark mist and clouds. Dramatic green, teal and purple aurora borealis lights up the night sky, sparks and red petals float in the air, dark fantasy style, cinematic lighting
